prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, healthy natural skin with real texture, not airbrushed, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: Lin Qingyu, a fictional 21-year-old, hero; Su Yaqing's younger stepbrother, secretly a wealthy young boss with his own assistant, posing as an ordinary college student to win Ji Ran; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: Strikingly handsome young East Asian man of 21 with a fresh, boyish, clearly younger look. He has a clean, slim V-shaped face with smooth youthful contours, a defined but gentle jawline, a straight, slender nose and full, soft lips. His eyes are large, round-ish, bright and intelligent, with a warm sparkle and a slight upturn at the corners, under soft natural brows. His smile is boyish and dimpled, with a hint of mischief. His skin is clear, fresh and healthy, with natural texture, and he is clean-shaven. His black hair is short and soft, with a fluffy, slightly tousled fringe falling to his brows; it is never styled up or slicked back. He is very tall at 186 cm and 64 kg: long-limbed and lean with broad shoulders, a lean, athletic swimmer's build and defined lean abdominal muscles. He wears a slim black silicone sports watch and a thin braided black cord bracelet.. Wearing one outfit only: At his sister's home: a soft white cotton pullover hoodie with a kangaroo pocket and drawstrings, its sleeves pushed up to the forearm, over light beige drawstring cotton jogger trousers cuffed at the ankle, with clean white low-top sneakers and white crew socks. A relaxed, youthful college look.. Signature colour: white. In the close-up a calm, attractive expression with bright, intelligent eyes and only a hint of: Sunny, sweet and puppyish on the surface, but calculating, decisive and quietly powerful underneath. He has long had his eye on Ji Ran and will play any role to get close to her. He enjoys needling rivals with innocent-sounding barbs.; no tears. The full-body views keep the body's build and proportions as the appearance gives them, head-to-body ratio included, never slimmer. Cast as a commercial live-action short drama: an adult lead (the heroine, the hero) or a young adult woman in a prominent role is a strikingly beautiful or handsome, camera-ready actor, with the figure, make-up, hair and fitted outfit the appearance and outfit give; a character under 18 looks and dresses like an ordinary child or teenager of that age and is never styled to look sexy; any other supporting role is an ordinary-looking person of that age.
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 21, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
